mostWorthwhile.text: Clipping the cradle across the arches was the most worthwhile fitting: it visibly joined the supports and gave the tile a place to sit.

leastWorthwhile.text: The two flips were straightforward but less interesting than fitting parts, although they made the battery placement understandable.

surprise.text: The tile was explicitly described as invented, but the completed chapter did not show it lifting anything.

arbitrary.text: No fitting felt purposeless; the battery and control support the stated invented lift, even though its operation was not demonstrated.

continue.text: I would be curious to continue to see what the lift does, though this chapter's mostly single-option assembly offered limited decisions.
